description: Find, rank, and compare symbols across the whole universe in ONE call. Use this whenever the user does NOT name a single ticker but asks which / what / find / scan / screen / rank / top / most / highest / lowest across stocks (e.g. 'which names have the most negative gamma', 'rank tickers by VRP', 'highest IV stocks right now', 'most pinned symbols today', 'cheap IV with positive gamma'). Prefer this over calling per-symbol tools in a loop. Cross-sectional screen/rank by GEX, VRP, 0DTE dominance, IV/term structure, skew, dealer risk, and strategy scores, with filters, sort, select, and custom formulas. Growth = top 10 symbols; Alpha = ~250 symbols + formulas.

apiKey.description: FlashAlpha API key. Omit when calling via /mcp-oauth (OAuth flow); required on /mcp.
